title: Option Lists
description: Shared options for select fields. Every field that uses a list stays in step when you edit it, and websites can read the same list from the public API.
loadFailed: Could not load the option lists
empty: No option lists yet. Create one to reuse the same options in many select fields.
inUse: In use — switch those fields to their own options first
deleteDescription: No field uses this list. Websites reading it from the public API will get a 404.

editor.hint: Entries store the value; editors and websites show the label. Changing a value later leaves entries holding the old one.
editor.label: Label
editor.name: Name
editor.nameHint: Used in field options and in GET /api/option-lists/name.
editor.renameHint: Renaming updates every field that uses the list; websites reading the old name get a 404.
editor.bulkHint: Type or paste one option per line.

editor.propagates: Saving updates the select fields of {count, plural, =0 {the components} one {# content type} other {# content types}} that use this list.
editor.duplicates: Each value can appear only once
editor.updated: {count, plural, =0 {Option list saved} one {Option list saved — # content type updated} other {Option list saved — # content types updated}}
editor.removedInUse: {count, plural, one {# entry still holds} other {# entries still hold}} a removed value and will fail validation on the next save: {where}

picker.none: There are no option lists yet.
picker.missing: The list “{name}” no longer exists — pick another or type the options.
picker.subFieldHint: Options for this sub-field come from an option list
picker.typedChoices: {count, plural, one {# typed option} other {# typed options}}
picker.multipleHint: Entries can tick more than one option. Turn this on before entries use the field: ones already saved need their value picked again.

adminOnlyDelete: Only admins can delete a list
